rebecca: Quick heads-up: were opening a small G100m (memory-optimized) Dedicated burst pool in us-west2 (SFO) and asia-southeast1 (SG) starting 2026-06-24 08:00 PT.

infra-bot: provision job #g100m-307 -> SUCCESS :white_check_mark: (2 zones per region, 6 GPUs/zone)

evan: Burst windows: 05:00-19:00 local. Non-guaranteed nodes; will preempt for reserved commitments.

rebecca: Policy: per-org rolling 24h cap = 40 GPU-hours across these pools while we ramp. Were labeling UI as "burst - g100m" and billing as "dedicated.burst.g100m".

billing: Note for AMs: customers above the cap will get automated outreach and a billing breakdown in Console.

sre-oncall: Smoke test scheduled Friday 06:00 PT. Expect brief elevated errors (~3-6m). Teams: validate fallback and retry logic.

rebecca: Action items: product/dev teams validate region fallback by EOD Wednesday. Infra: monitor preemption_rate and unusual egress. Ping me if >5% preempt on any route.
